content.text: 10-second cinematic live-action Han-period grain warehouse conversation, first-person eye-level medium close shot. Warehouse operator matches the young grey-robed man in reference 1; reference 2 only warehouse space. He stands behind table, face and hands visible, holding a folded paper with PLAIN BACK facing camera at waist level. He never opens or turns the paper, no ink, no writing, no labels, no subtitles, no document cards, no rectangles, no blur/mosaic. 0-1s he looks at listener, then 1-7s calmly says the ONLY permitted line: “这是仓里留的缺额报告。村名、批次都和交接记录对得上。” 7-10s he offers the folded paper toward player; player's hands grip the plain folded back, operator releases, player lowers it out of frame. Show a natural complete handoff, no extra page materialization. Camera stays eye-level, small natural tilt down only at handoff, no extreme closeup of paper. Sharp cloth and skin, overcast daylight, coherent hands. Voice whitelist exactly the quoted sentence spoken by warehouse operator; no role names, stage directions, narration, player voice, or additional words. No BGM, no background music, no score; synchronize his single line, sleeve rustle and paper handoff only.
